title: Compose Technology Leakage Eradication
description: Compose is legacy technology and must not appear anywhere inside framework, s, .storybook, or other non-compose trees. Scrub all path imports, package aliases, fixtures, storybook scopes/stories, asset brand folders, scan roots, and vite stubs that couple modern trees to ./compose. Keep puzzle domain compose (composition engine) if it is not the compose technology. Repo tooling may retain skip/exempt awareness of the compose root only as an isolation boundary, not as an integration surface.
